name: AnnouncementBar
description: Dismissible announcement bar with optional action, tone and sticky positioning.
designIntent: Launches, content hubs and network notices need a thin bar above the header. AnnouncementBar owns the message, action and dismissal without forcing the site header to grow more props.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Action text, shown when href is provided.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called after the user dismisses the bar.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pin the bar to the top of the viewport.

examples.title: Content hub launch
examples.code:
<AnnouncementBar
  message="The 2026 Middle Market Review is live"
  href="/forum"
  actionLabel="Read it"
  tone="brand"
/>
examples.description: A branded announcement with a link and dismissal.

antiPatterns.title: Don't stack multiple announcements
antiPatterns.explanation: One bar per page. Multiple messages compete and push the header down.

accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the message short and actionable

accessibility.implementation: The close button is named Dismiss announcement
accessibility.userRequirements: Persist or reset dismissal in the caller when needed

compositionRules.relationship: Place AnnouncementBar above the sticky header
